thread:
sara.customer: Hey team — getting repeated 400s when calling the tool endpoint with a tool_args payload. Works locally but fails via our frontend. Error: "invalid_tool_args: JSON parse error at offset 34"

maria.support: Sorry to hear that, can you paste the exact request you sent (curl or SDK) + the full error body? Also which model/tool combo?

sara.customer: Sure — using POST /v1/tools/run with tool "file_reader.open" and body below. Frontend posts this raw as the tool_args value (we're forwarding a string field from the client):

```
POST /v1/tools/run HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.example
Content-Type: application/json
Authorization: Bearer xxxxx

{
  "tool": "file_reader.open",
  "tool_args": '{"path":"C:\Users\Dïanä\Documents\notes.txt", "mode":"r"}'
}
```

Response: 400 {
  "error": "invalid_tool_args",
  "message": "JSON parse error: unexpected character at position 34"
}

Note: the client is a webapp that serializes the inner JSON as a single-quoted string (to avoid double-escaping in our frontend templates). It also sometimes pastes text from Word which may introduce weird quotes.

maria.support: Thanks. Two quick asks: (1) can you reproduce with curl from the server (so we rule out client template escaping)? (2) can you share the raw bytes (hexdump) of the request body if possible — curious about non-ASCII bytes.

sara.customer: Repro from our server (curl) shows same error. Hex snippet of the tool_args substring: 7b 22 70 61 74 68 22 3a 22 43 3a 5c 5c 55 73 65 72 73 5c 5c 44 c3 af 61 6e  c3 a4 5c 5c 44 6f 63 75 6d 65 6e 74 73 5c 5c 6e 6f 74 65 73 2e 74 78 74 22 2c 20 22 6d 6f 64 65 22 3a 22 72 22 7d

maria.support: That hex shows UTF-8 multi-byte bytes (c3 af, c3 a4) for the name Dïanä. The parser should handle UTF-8 inside the inner JSON string, but I think the problem is we accept tool_args as a raw string that may itself contain unescaped double quotes — your client used single quotes around the inner JSON which ends up arriving as: '{"path":"C:\\Users..."}' vs proper JSON.

kevin-eng: Jumping in — thanks for the report and the repro steps. Two bugs to call out:
1) Our tool-arguments parser treats the incoming tool_args as JSON if it starts with a quote character, but we have a heuristic that strips wrapping single quotes. That code path fails when the inner string contains non-ASCII bytes followed by backslashes — the UTF-8 multi-byte sequences confuse an index calculation and we hit an out-of-range, leading to the generic parse error.
2) We also don't canonicalize curly/smart quotes. If the client pasted “ or ” (left/right double quotation mark) into the string, the inner JSON becomes invalid.

Workarounds: 
- Ensure the client sends tool_args as a proper JSON object (not a string). Example safe curl: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/tools/run 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxxxx' 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
  -d '{"tool":"file_reader.open","tool_args": {"path": "C:\\\Users\\Dïanä\\Documents\notes.txt","mode":"r"}}'
```
- If the pipeline must send a string, base64-encode the inner JSON and set a metadata flag, we accept base64 in the short term. Example: 
```json
{"tool":"file_reader.open","tool_args_b64":"eyJwYXRoIjoiQzpcXF..."}
```

maria.support: Thanks Kevin — can you open an engineering issue and add the minimal reproducer (we have the hex + curl) so runtime can patch the UTF-8 index calc? Also can we return a more specific error message to customers instead of the opaque "JSON parse error at offset"?

kevin-eng: Will do. I'll open ENG-RUNTIME issue 1423 and add the reproducer. For immediate customer-facing change, I can add a heuristic in the front door to reject single-quoted inner JSON with a 400 and a message: "tool_args must be a JSON object or a double-quoted JSON string; avoid single-quoted payloads or smart quotes". That should be a small patch.

deploy-bot: Created issue ENG-RUNTIME-1423: 
https://github.com/redwood-inference/eng-runtime/issues/1423 (assigned to kevin-eng)

sara.customer: Thanks — the base64 workaround worked for our frontend. Please keep me posted on the fix; we'll roll the client patch to stop single-quoting inner JSON. :thumbsup:

maria.support: Marking as escalated to eng and adding to the customer case. Escalation note: reproducible parsing failure when tool_args provided as single-quoted string containing UTF-8 multi-byte chars + backslashes; temporary workaround = base64 or send as JSON object.

kevin-eng: ETA for front-door guard + clearer error message is ~48 hours, full fix to index calculation by runtime team targeted in next sprint. I'll post updates in the GH issue.

maria.support: Great, closing the support thread for now and will update the customer case with the workaround and ETA.

sara.customer: Appreciate it, thanks!
